notes.title: Content Update: Restaurant Biome
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to release a new, free content update for our colorful puzzler, One Line Coloring. This time, we are taking you on a coffee to a restaurant, serving delicious treats to solve. 

20 polished models in a new diorama set is ready for you to enjoy, including coffee cups, cupcakes, kettles, an armchair or a delightful vending machine, each offering a challenge and quite a skill to solve.

We are happy to finally share this first piece of content for One Line Coloring and look forward to introduce even more delighful scenes to our dotted puzzle adventure!

Your fellow puzzle maker,
MythicOwl

notes.title: Input and UI improvements patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, we would like to thank you for ongoing support and trusting us with our new game, One Line Coloring. We appreciate the reception and want to continue upgrading our colorful puzzler, according to the gathered feedback from you - the players.

First patch addresses some UI and interface related issues. We want to make your experience with our game as pleasant and relaxing, as it can be. Here is a full list of changes:


- Players can now quickly restart the level while playing on a gamepad, by simply pressing LT+RT together
- Players can now hide the timer by clicking on it
- 'Undo' button was added to the gameplay interface (right mouse click still works as undo as well)


Follow our Publisher Account here on Steam and stay tuned for more patches and content updates, as we have lots of new stuff to introduce in the upcoming weeks!

MythicOwl Team

notes.title: Our new, charming puzzler is now available on Steam with 15% release discount!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Finally the release day! We are excited and happy to share our newest game with you. It is a new approach to a well-established idea of drawing shapes - only this time, updated with beautiful 3D models, that come to life as collectibles. It is your task to complete charming dioramas. 

We also prepared a new release trailer so jump in and enjoy the colorful world of One Line Coloring!

[previewyoutube=aFkp1hXyRsY;full][/previewyoutube]

We also would like to thank you for ongoing support and hope you will like our newest addition to the relaxing puzzles family!

MythicOwl Team
